Method of Attack: Typosquatting to trick developers into downloading malicious packages
Execution of a PowerShell script during package installation to change system configuration and fetch a secondary payload
Delivery of a secondary payload designed to steal cryptocurrency, extract and execute code from Electron archives, and drop an updater executable
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running older versions of Visual Studio
Attack Vector: Abuse of the 'tools' directory in older Visual Studio versions to execute scripts automatically
Execution of malicious PowerShell scripts during package installation
Indicators of Compromise: Secondary payload fetched from a remote server
Malware designed to steal cryptocurrency and ensure persistence
